dedupe_keys.name: lifecycle ageing tests on commercial 18650 li ion cell 10 c and 0 c

description: TÜV SÜD provides cycling-ageing results for commercial 18650 cells with a nickel-rich positive electrode and silicon/graphite negative electrode. The title identifies environmental temperatures of zero and ten degrees Celsius. Each condition uses two cells, with different C-rates. The state-of-charge window is ten to ninety percent, defined from fresh cells and kept fixed as ageing proceeds. Reference tests interrupt cycling. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent collection establishes calibration inputs for predicting electric-vehicle battery behaviour, lifetime and range. Coverage: exact measurement periods remain unstated. Access: public native metadata describes the release and stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: A related native deposit contains calendar-ageing tests at the same named temperatures. C-rates, sampling intervals and cell-to-cell variation are not quantified in the reviewed metadata.
